method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.description:
Predict the gender of a person from their name. Returns the most
likely gender ('male' or 'female'), a probability score, and the count
of people with that name in the underlying dataset. Optionally scope
by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Accepts a single name or a list of
up to 100 names per call.

country_id.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'DK', 'US') to scope predictions

name.description: A single name (full name or first) or a list of up to 100 names

tools.name: predict_gender
tools.title: predict_gender
